name: GTK 3 SDK
summary: GTK 3 and ATK, with headers, import libraries and introspection data, to build GTK 3 apps with the GTK 4 SDK, which has the rest of the stack

modules.name: about
build: printf '%s\r\n' '@echo off' 'echo GTK 3 for apps built with zigsaw. It needs the GTK 4 runtime, org.gtk.Gtk4, for GLib, Pango, cairo and the rest:' 'echo an app lists both. gtk3-demo is org.gtk.Gtk3demo.' > "$PREFIX/about.bat"

modules.name: gtk
build: sed -i 's/^  if (g_strcmp0 (desktopdir, g_get_home_dir ()) != 0)$/  if (desktopdir != NULL \&\& g_strcmp0 (desktopdir, g_get_home_dir ()) != 0)/' gtk/gtkfilechooserbutton.c
sed -i 's/^  if (!g_strcmp0 (name, g_get_home_dir ()))$/  if (name == NULL || !g_strcmp0 (name, g_get_home_dir ()))/' gtk/gtkfilechooserwidget.c
sed -i 's/^  if (path_is_home_dir (name))$/  if (name == NULL || path_is_home_dir (name))/' gtk/gtkplacessidebar.c
sed -i "s/^  install: true$/  win_subsystem: 'windows',\n  install: true/" demos/gtk-demo/meson.build demos/widget-factory/meson.build demos/icon-browser/meson.build

grep -q 'desktopdir != NULL && g_strcmp0' gtk/gtkfilechooserbutton.c && grep -q 'name == NULL || !g_strcmp0 (name, g_get_home_dir' gtk/gtkfilechooserwidget.c && grep -q 'name == NULL || path_is_home_dir (name)' gtk/gtkplacessidebar.c
